name: American Basswood

facts.what: Flowers for tea; tender young leaves
facts.how: Flowers steeped; young leaves raw in salad
facts.value: Mild and sweet; a calming tea

caution: Use fresh flowers for tea, not old browning ones. Young leaves are a mild salad green. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Big heart-shaped leaves and fragrant pale flowers that hang from a strap-like bract. Also called linden.

sections.title: Uses
sections.body: Linden flower tea is a classic soothing brew, honey-sweet and floral; the tender spring leaves make a pleasant salad.
